title: CapacityFile
description: v1/capacity/rolling-30d.json. Hourly day-ahead forecasted transfer capacity (NTC) per border and direction, 30 days back to 24 h ahead. Source: ENTSO-E data item 'Forecasted cross-zonal capacity, day-ahead' (Transparency Regulation article 11.1.a). All values have state planned or missing. Show as 'planned capacity'.

DirectedCapacity.title: DirectedCapacity
DirectedCapacity.description: Capacity for one direction of one border: the most power in MW that can be traded from from_zone to to_zone in each hour. Values are 0 or more. Capacity is not netted: a border has up to two entries, one per direction. A direction with no published capacity is left out.
